_estimator: newline_margin_freeze.margin(prefix=[], nl=t) imported as the oracle; the production path is the same forward pass as selfcont_set.batched, keeping the top-8 instead of the maximum
_logit_scale: 1e-4, stored as integers; see selfcont_set.py for why floats are not stored

_oracle_check.note: the imported estimator's margin against top1-minus-top2 here. This checks the RIVAL, not only the margin.

_analysis_provenance.note: sha256 of the analysis source at write time, plus the repo-local import closure. If any of these does not match the file on disk, the analysis was produced by a different version of the code -- re-run it before reading the numbers (issue #38; the imports half closes the same hole one level down the import graph). Third-party package versions are NOT covered.
